answer.summary: 日志 L132 在 Sun Dec 04 05:15:09 2005 记录：[client <IP>] Directory index forbidden by rule: /var/www/html/。这是可观察现象，根因尚未确认。
hypotheses: 需结合版本、配置、访问日志和相邻时间记录验证；单一事件模板不能证明因果关系。

对照相邻日志、错误级别计数及文档中的适用版本。

Directory index forbidden by rule is an observed access denial. DirectoryIndex chooses an index file; automatic directory listing depends on Options Indexes. Read the effective directory configuration and index file availability. Do not enable directory listing as a blanket fix. The log alone does not establish which configuration caused denial.
